about: A template reads what is there, at every step (chapter 5 § 5.3.1). The agent closing places the macro hpi of the folder section_notes. Invalid: it reads macro.section_notes.hpi.anything, which the macro does not have. Valid: it places macro.section_notes.hpi.
sentences: Node 'closing' reads macro.section_notes.hpi.anything at line 2, which macro.section_notes.hpi doesn't have.
